title: Articulating Assumptions in AI-Generated Scientific Analyses through Task Decomposition
abstract: arXiv:2607.05762v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Scientific results produced by LLM generated analysis code must be understandable and reproducible. However, uncertainty can arise at different stages of the process, both in the original natural language specification and in the generated implementation. As a result, even executable code may not provide a clear understanding of which quantities are being computed or which assumptions determine the final results. To address this challenge, we introduce quantity grounded semantic differencing, a multi-agent framework for analyzing and comparing scientific programs generated by LLMs. The framework assigns code generation, execution, tracing, and validation to separate agents, allowing it to reconstruct how key output quantities are produced and to identify differences between the intended analysis and the implemented code. translated_title: 通过任务分解阐明AI生成科学分析中的假设
translated_abstract: 由大语言模型生成的分析代码所产生的科学结果必须易于理解且可复现。然而，不确定性可能在流程的不同阶段产生，既存在于原始的自然语言规范中，也存在于生成的代码实现中。因此，即使是可执行的代码，也可能无法清晰地说明正在计算哪些量，或者哪些假设决定了最终结果。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了“基于量化语义差异比较”，这是一个用于分析和比较由大语言模型生成的科学程序的多智能体框架。该框架将代码生成、执行、追踪和验证分配给不同的智能体，从而能够重建关键输出量是如何产生的，并识别预期分析与实际实现代码之间的差异。我们还引入了一个模块，用于检查初始用户指令中的歧义并提出替代性的重写建议。
tldr: 提出多智能体框架“基于量化语义差异比较”，通过任务分解揭示AI生成科学分析代码中的隐含假设，重建关键输出量的产生过程并检测用户指令中的歧义。
en_tdlr: Introduces a multi-agent framework called "quantity grounded semantic differencing" that articulates hidden assumptions in LLM-generated scientific analysis code through task decomposition, reconstructing how key output quantities are produced and detecting ambiguities in user instructions.
